fallback.text: An 8-shaft warp satin: each pick leaves exactly one end down, and the next pick moves that point by the same number of ends (the move). With a move of 3 (or 5) the interlacing points never touch, so the surface is smooth with no diagonal line: a regular satin. Moves 1 and 7 give a twill, and moves 2, 4 and 6 share a factor with 8, so some ends never interlace. Every end floats over 7 picks, and the sett for yarn of 30 wraps per inch is 30 × 8 / (8 + 2) = 24 ends per inch.
